about: Routing facts for agents: the sibling repos this hub knows, what each is for, and when to read it. Each is maintained separately; read the one the task needs and link its rules rather than restating them. A sibling pin, when there is one, lives only in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json; none is pinned today, so CI reads each sibling at its default branch. Checked by evals/siblings/run.py.

repos.name: local-ai
repos.purpose: Run AI on your own hardware so private information never leaves the machine: open models and runtimes, a small local classifier, private document search, and tools for finding and removing personal information.
read_when: data may never reach a hosted model
choosing a local model or runtime for the hardware you have
finding or redacting personal information before a model sees it

repos.name: opensource
repos.purpose: Open-source projects to build on instead of starting from scratch, for games and for software beyond games, each with its license read from GitHub and a plain rule for what you may reuse.
read_when: starting a game or a tool from existing open source
deciding what a project's license lets you copy
looking for a self-hosted or open-source tool before building one

repos.name: homelab
repos.purpose: Practice from running a small home lab, each rule with the failure behind it and a check you can run: WSL, systemd user services, networking, sync and backup, alerting.
read_when: running services on your own machines
a service or check reports healthy while doing nothing
setting up alerting, backup or remote access at home

repos.name: ai-redteam
repos.purpose: Adversarial review for AI-produced work: red-team decisions, plans, claims and code, bounded pull request review, and an assess skill for incoming links, with a published eval set.
read_when: a plan, claim, decision or piece of code needs a second, adversarial opinion before anyone relies on it
reviewing one pull request with a written adjudication
someone forwards a link or tool and asks whether it is useful

repos.name: factcheck
repos.purpose: A fact-check skill for marketing and product claims: dated, claim-by-claim ratings from the seller's own pages, checked arithmetic and clearly separated independent evidence.
read_when: checking marketing or product claims against the seller's own pages and independent evidence
rating a claim as supported, contradicted, incomplete or missing support
building or reviewing a fact-check skill or paste-in prompt
